name: Clean Up Service
summary: In Clean Up Service, the crazy cowboy cleaners Otto and Bobban return to rid the Addle Hotel of mutant trash. Across eight platform levels, you dash through large hotel sections, collecting items like brooms, trash can lids, and stun guns while avoiding hostile garbage piles. Every hit costs a life, so quick reflexes are essential. The final destination is the enchanted attic, and in two-player mode both players clean up together on screen.
